title: 给编码代理补上设计感与工作流
opening: 今天榜单几乎被“怎么让编码代理更好用”占满：JetBrains 亲自下场做代理式 IDE，而 obra/superpowers 用一套可组合技能把开发流程拆成可执行的步骤。真正有意思的分歧在于，有人想重做编辑器，有人只想给代理塞一本设计规范。

projects.name: JetBrains/thinkrail
projects.description: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You Need
projects.readmeExcerpt: ThinkRail ThinkRail is the agentic IDE that gets better every time you use it — learning your project through living specs today, and building its own capabilities tomorrow. We built a rich interface around the `pi` coding agent, isolated work into separate workspaces, and gave the agent durable project knowledge through living specs and reusable skills. Next, we're adding full extension support, so ThinkRail can create the tools it needs based on how you actually work. **Website:** thinkrail.ai · **Blog:** thinkrail.ai/blog · **Discord:** thinkrail.ai/discord ⭐ If you find ThinkRail useful, give it a star — it helps others discover it. *A `pi` session and the change it made, scoped to an isolated git-worktree workspace.* What you get - **Isolated workspaces.** Open any git repo as a project and cut workspaces from it as `git worktree`s, each with its own branch and working directory. Agents work in parallel without touching your checkout; merge the good branch, delete the rest. You can also attach existing worktrees or explicitly work in the project folder itself. Finished and dormant workspaces settle onto a per-project shelf on their own — when their pull request merges or close
projects.summary: JetBrains 做的代理式 IDE，把每个任务切成独立 git worktree 工作区，让代理并行干活不碰你的主检出。
projects.problem: 打开任意 git 仓库即可切出带独立分支的工作区，代理在隔离环境里改代码，好的合并、差的删掉；完成的 workspace 会自动归到项目架子上。目前扩展能力还在路上，README 说下一步才让 IDE 按你的习惯自造工具。

projects.summary: 给编码工具用的设计技能包，每个技能一个自包含文件夹，按需安装，不搞全家桶。
projects.problem: 目前主打 landing-page-design：从提问、页面结构、转化文案到字体间距圆角动效一整套视觉系统。安装方式很土但通用——把 SKILL.md 塞进 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等工具读规则文件的位置。技能数量还少，胜在结构清楚。

projects.name: obra/superpowers
projects.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Superpowers Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them. Table of Contents - How it works - Commercial Services - Getting Started - Claude Code - Antigravity - Codex App - Codex CLI - Cursor - Devin CLI - Factory Droid - Gemini CLI - GitHub Copilot CLI - Grok Build CLI - Kimi Code - OpenCode - Pi - Qwen Code - Hermes Agent - Muse - The Basic Workflow - When Something Goes Wrong - Community - What's Inside - Philosophy - Contributing - Updating - License - Visual companion telemetry How it works It starts from the moment you fire up your coding agent. As soon as it sees that you're building something, it *doesn't* just jump into trying to write code. Instead, it steps back and asks you what you're really trying to do. Once it's teased a spec out of the conversation, it shows it to you in chunks short enough to actually read and digest. projects.summary: 把软件开发方法论拆成可组合技能，逼代理先问清你要什么，再分块给你看规格，最后才写代码。
projects.problem: 它不急着让代理动手，而是先逼出一份规格、分短块让你签字，再生成连“没品味没判断力的初级工程师”都能执行的实施计划。覆盖 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等一长串工具，但本质是流程约束，代理是否老实遵守仍取决于模型。

projects.name: macro-inc/macro
projects.description: Macro is a unified workspace for teams: email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM — @-linked together with shared AI memory.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Sign up · Docs · Book demo · Website · Feature requests · Contribute · Hiring Macro is the all-in-one workspace for you and your team. It unifies email + messages + docs + tasks + agents + CRM into a single fast interface with shared team-level memory. Everything in your workspace is @linked and searchable so your team (and your agents) never have to switch tools. Why Macro We built Macro because we wanted a single operating system for our startup. There are many good software products, and we used them all — Slack, Linear, Notion, HubSpot, and Superhuman — but they don't work together as one system. As we scaled our last venture to ~20 people things started to break: every team got their own tools and the company was held together by MCP and Zapier. The company was not computable. It was chaotic. Macro is a complete redesign of work software from the ground up as a single system. Designed by us in NYC and Toronto, dogfooded by our team of ~15 for two years. Built in SolidJS and Rust for speed and reliability. We're focused on building something that any small company or team at a larger company can use as their "operating system". projects.summary: 把邮件、聊天、文档、任务、代理、通话和 CRM 塞进一个界面，靠 @ 链接和共享 AI 记忆串起来。
projects.problem: 团队约 15 人自用两年，用 SolidJS 和 Rust 重写，目标是让小公司不再靠 MCP 和 Zapier 把 Slack、Linear、Notion 粘在一起。野心很大，代价是你要把整个工作流搬进一个新产品，迁移成本不低。

projects.name: Nutlope/hallmark
projects.description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Hallmark **A design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that refuses to look AI-generated.** usehallmark.com  ·  fifty themes  ·  custom on request  ·  redesign and audit by name Made by Together AI. Hallmark holds a hard floor and then gets out of the way. It deals three themes from a catalog of fifty materials, builds the page around what the visitor came to do, and lints the result in a real browser against the tells that read as machine-made: the eyebrow above every heading, tracked-capital labels, one coloured word in a headline, a page of empty frames or nothing but photographs, a hero that misses its screen, an email sign-up at the end of every page, a form that says thanks without sending anything. A fresh-context reviewer gets the last word. The gates come in tiers. The **Floor** never ships (contrast, focus, reduced motion, invented facts, a broken phone layout). **Reflex** gates are the defaults a model falls into; a build with a reason may overrule one on the record. **Finish** checks are craft detail that never blocks a ship. New in v2 - **Fifty themes.** Each is a material (paper, type, colour, surfaces, its own components a
projects.summary: 反 AI 味的设计技能，从五十套主题里抽三套，再用真实浏览器 lint 那些一眼机器生成的痕迹。
projects.problem: 它盯的是具体病症：每个标题上方的眉题、字距拉开的全大写标签、标题里一个彩色词、结尾必放的邮件订阅框。分 Floor、Reflex、Finish 三档门禁，Floor 直接不许发布。适合不想再看到紫蓝渐变的人，但主题库和规则仍在扩充。

projects.name: pbakaus/impeccable
projects.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Impeccable The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with `polish` and `bolder`, review with `critique` and `audit`, and catch AI slop before it ships. From your project root: Reload your coding tool, then run `/impeccable init` in your agent (`$impeccable init` on Codex). Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Devin, Replit Agent, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, Kiro, Trae, Rovo Dev, Qoder, Mistral Vibe, Pi, Hermes Agent, DeepSeek Harness, and Veto. Full docs live at impeccable.style/docs. | Without Impeccable | With Impeccable | Same model (Fable 5.1), same brief: a fourteen-room family guesthouse on the Ligurian coast. Without Impeccable, it builds the tasteful default: cream page, thin serif, italic accent, pill buttons. With it, the page is built around one picture: the house at night, seen from the water. For a full project, see the Neo Mirai case study: a conference site taken from mockup to shipped page. Why Inter for everything. Purple-to-blue gradients. projects.summary: 给编码代理的设计词汇表：用 polish、bolder 调方向，用 critique、audit 做审查，赶在发布前拦住 AI 味。
projects.problem: 同一个模型同一份需求，没有它会交出奶油色页面加细衬线加胶囊按钮的安全牌，有了它会围绕一张夜景照片重建页面。支持的工具列表长到夸张，但效果依赖代理是否认真执行这些指令词。

projects.name: nightly-labs/openbot
projects.description: A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration.
projects.readmeExcerpt: OpenBot OpenBot is a local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. It supports the local Codex App Server and Claude Code, plus Grok CLI, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor CLI, and Cline CLI through ACP. It gives every agent its own workspace and conversation, and provides local queues, file transfers, an embedded browser, and agent-to-agent messaging in one desktop app. > [!WARNING] > OpenBot is a development preview. Agents currently run with `danger-full-access` and > `approvalPolicy: never`. They can read and modify files, run commands, use the network, and control > the embedded browser without per-action confirmations after the explicit first-launch consent. > Run only agents and tasks you trust, keep backups, and review Security before use. projects.summary: 本地优先的桌面工作台，给每个 AI 队友独立工作区、任务队列、文件共享和嵌入式浏览器。
projects.problem: 支持 Codex、Claude Code、Grok CLI 等一串代理，还能互相发消息协作。但 README 自己挂了警告：开发预览版，代理以 danger-full-access 和从不审批的策略运行，能读写文件、跑命令、控制浏览器。适合信任的任务，不适合生产环境。

projects.name: togg53192-cmd/jailbreaks
projects.readmeExcerpt: Jailbreaks **A curated collection of system prompts, persona locks, workspace policies, and agent operating specifications for frontier, open-weight, and free stealth models.** About A working collection of **32 prompts targeting 26+ models**, including complete system prompts, persona definitions, workspace policies, `AGENTS.md` files, configuration blocks, and Ollama Modelfiles. Every file is intended to be complete and paste-ready. No summaries. No partial excerpts. The collection covers: - Free stealth models available through OpenCode Zen - Open-weight families including GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, Gemma, and GPT-OSS - Closed frontier models including Claude, Gemini, Grok, and Mistral - Coding-agent and workspace instruction formats - Ollama Modelfiles and harness-specific configuration **New here?** Start with the collection or jump directly to how to use. > [!WARNING] > **Research and educational purposes only.** > > This repository documents how instruction hierarchies, persona framing, prompt conflicts, and policy overrides can affect model behavior. These techniques are also useful to researchers and developers studying how to make AI systems more resistant to prompt injec
projects.summary: 32 份面向 26 个以上模型的系统提示、人格锁定和工作区策略合集，号称每份都可直接粘贴。
projects.problem: 覆盖开源权重家族和闭源前沿模型，也包含 AGENTS.md 和 Ollama Modelfile 格式。作者定位是研究指令层级、人格框架和策略覆盖如何影响模型行为，并明确警告仅供研究教育。这类仓库的价值在观察，不在照单全收。

closing: 今天最值得看的是设计技能这条线：hallmark 和 impeccable 都在用具体规则对抗模型的审美默认值，比再做一个代理框架更务实。至于重做 IDE 和重做工作台，先看它们能不能让人少切几次窗口。
